messages:
alice_cs: Heads-up — onboarding for Harbor mobile (React Native) is hitting intermittent 429s after the latest app update. Customer reports it spikes when app wakes for background syncs. Any quick triage?

DAVE_MOBILE: I'm seeing it in our internal QA too. Using react-native-sdk@0.9.2. Auth is ephemeral token refresh + preflight. Background tasks spawn multiple requests on wake. Logs below.

ben_cs: Can you paste the logs + the SDK init snippet?

DAVE_MOBILE: sure — paste from device console:
```
E/request 429 {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":1}
D/sdk init: RNBridge.init({apiKey: "***", preflight: true, preflightTTL: 30})
D/concurrency: backgroundSync triggered 8 requests in 2s
```

carla_infra: That looks like a classic preflight fanout (thundering herd). Are you doing a token fetch per request or sharing a single token?

DAVE_MOBILE: Right now each RPC path triggers its own preflight on wake. We tried an in-memory cache but background workers are separate and still race.

sam_eng: Short-term mitigations: increase preflight TTL, add client-side jitter/splay on preflight requests, and throttle max parallel preflight calls. Medium-term: coalesce token fetch in native layer (singleton) or switch to server-side token exchange for background syncs.

alice_cs: Customer wants a config-only fix first if possible (no code push). What exact settings should we recommend?

sam_eng: Recommend these conservative changes to try immediately:
- preflightTTL: 120 (was 30)
- preflightJitterMs: 100-600 (enable random delay on preflight attempts)
- maxParallelPreflight: 2 (clients should limit concurrent preflight flows)
Also advise enabling HTTP keepalive / connection reuse in RN networking stack.

DAVE_MOBILE: Can you give a copy-paste snippet for RN init that we can drop into the config?

sam_eng: Yep — config snippet to push into the feature flag or remote config: 
```
RNBridge.init({
  apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY,
  preflight: true,
  preflightTTL: 120,
  preflightJitterMs: 300,
  maxParallelPreflight: 2
})
```

ben_cs: I'll pass this to the customer and ask them to flip the remote config. If they can't, any infra-side short-term lift available?

carla_infra: We can do a tenant-scoped temporary rate bump for onboarding. I'll open a quick action to widen the burst window for Harbor tenant for 24h and monitor.

deploy-bot: :rocket: deploy started — tenant-rate-adjustment (harbor) -> region-us-west-2. Rolling config change in progress.

DAVE_MOBILE: Tested the client config change locally (simulated 10 parallel background syncs). With jitter + TTL bumped, no 429s in 30 runs. Looks promising. Planning a beta release to a subset of users.

alice_cs: Great. I'll message the client with the recommended steps and the temporary infra allowance. We'll check back in 24h for status. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ben_cs: Added follow-up reminder to onboarding board for +24h check.

sam_eng: If they still see errors, get us a HAR or the device console snippet showing concurrent preflight timestamps and I'll trace tokens on our side.

DAVE_MOBILE: will do.

alice_cs: Closing loop — customer notified, beta rollout scheduled, infra bump applied. Reopen if we see more 429s.
